facts.text: I am trying to create a budget.
I have been attending a weekly lecture series on "Personal Finance" at the library.
I want to put tips from the weekly "Personal Finance" lecture series into practice.
I want to focus on building an emergency fund first.
The last lecture in the series emphasized the importance of having an emergency fund.
I want help determining how much I should aim to save for my emergency fund.
I think setting up automatic transfers sounds like a good idea for saving for my emergency fund.
I am thinking of selling items I no longer need to put the money toward my emergency fund.
I have an old laptop that still works well.
I have a bunch of CDs that I no longer listen to.
I have gently used clothing that is still in good condition.
I think I can get around $500 to $700 for all of the items I plan to sell.
I plan to list my items on Facebook Marketplace and local online selling groups.
I have had good experiences with Facebook Marketplace and local online selling groups in the past.
I plan to list my laptop on eBay or Craigslist to reach a wider audience.
I plan to use Discogs to sell my CDs.
I plan to use Poshmark to sell my clothing.
